sentences.text: 1. Sri R.B Maurya, Advocate holding brief of Sri Harikrishna Rajesh, learned counsel for the applicants and Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State-respondent are present.

2. The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicants with a prayer to transfer the further proceeding of Case No. 115 of 2019, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P.Act, P.S. Aahar, District Bulandshahr, pending in the Court of Civil Judge(Junior Division)/Judicial Magistrate, Anoopshahr, (Bulandshahr) to district Ghaziabad.
3.

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge(Junior Division)/Judicial Magistrate, Anoopshahr, (Bulandshahr)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicant no. 1 is husband of the opposite party no. 2 and rest of applicants are his family members and however, they filed instant transfer application with a prayer to transfer the trial of the case relates to offence under section 498 A IPC from District Bulandshahr to District Ghaziabad but applicants are ready to appear through video conferencing and therefore, the instant application may be disposed off with the direction that if applicant filed an application before appropriate forum to appear through video conferencing then their application shall be entertained and they will be permitted to appear through video conferencing.
4.
Learned AGA is having no objection.

5. The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicants with a prayer to transfer the case from District Bulandshahar to District Ghaziabad but now they are ready to pursue the matter through video conferencing, therefore, instant transfer application is being disposed off with a direction that if applicants filed an application to pursue through video conferencing then their application shall be considered and they will be permitted to pursue the matter through video conferencing.

(Sameer Jain,J.) November 6, 2025 Ankita  Manish And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17931049/
